standard_prerequisites.name: The gluing category Glue(B -> B-hat, f_1, ..., f_r) and the equivalence of the glueing theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the formalism that converts the local splitting data into the finite B-algebra D.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale base change trivial modulo I and lifting of idempotents
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the ring B' and the idempotent e that splits D.

standard_prerequisites.name: Complete pairs are henselian, and the characterisation of henselian pairs
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the map to C x C' to be factored through the etale extension, which is what makes the replacement of B legitimate.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness of the completion map and the isomorphism B/IB -> B-hat/IB-hat
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the hypothesis that lets the glueing equivalence be applied to the completed situation.

core_obligations: Use that B-hat is Noetherian to conclude J is finitely generated, and deduce from the idempotent criterion that C_f = ((B-hat)_f)_e for some idempotent e in (B-hat)_f (proof lines 32046-32055).

Apply the gluing lemma on sum components over an open cover to find a surjection B-hat -> C' such that B-hat -> C x C' becomes an isomorphism after inverting any f in I, and note C x C' is a finite B-hat-algebra (proof lines 32056-32060).

Choose generators f_1, ..., f_r of I and define the alpha_i as the inverses of the obtained isomorphisms and the alpha_{ij} as the obvious B-algebra isomorphisms, forming the object (C x C', B_{f_i}, alpha_i, alpha_{ij}) of the gluing category; the verification of conditions (1)(a) and (1)(b) is stated to be omitted (proof lines 32062-32074).

Apply the equivalence proposition and the formal gluing remark, legitimate because B -> B-hat is flat and induces an isomorphism B/IB -> B-hat/IB-hat, to conclude that C x C' is isomorphic to D tensor_B B-hat for some finite B-algebra D (proof lines 32075-32081).

Let e-bar in D/ID be the idempotent corresponding to the factor C/IC, and use the idempotent-lifting lemma to find an etale ring map B -> B' inducing an isomorphism B/IB -> B'/IB' such that D' = D tensor_B B' contains an idempotent e lifting e-bar (proof lines 32082-32087).

Use that C x C' is I-adically complete, hence the pair (C x C', IC x IC') is henselian, and the characterisation of henselian pairs to factor B -> C x C' through B'; replace B by B' and D by D' (the I-adic completions being unaltered) (proof lines 32088-32093).

Conclude that D = D_e x D_{1-e} = D/(1-e) x D/(e) is a product of finite type A-algebras whose completions are C and C' respectively, giving the required identification of C (proof lines 32094-32096).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a Noetherian ring A, an ideal I, a finite type A-algebra B, and a surjection B-hat -> C with kernel J, and assumes J/J^2 is annihilated by I^c for some c >= 0; it concludes that C is isomorphic to the completion of a finite type A-algebra (source lines 32036-32043). The proof is a long chain of reductions rather than a single citation. It first uses that B-hat is Noetherian to make J finitely generated, then deduces from an idempotent criterion that C_f = ((B-hat)_f)_e for some idempotent e, and uses a gluing lemma to find a complementary surjection B-hat -> C' such that B-hat -> C x C' becomes an isomorphism after inverting any f in I (proof lines 32046-32060). Choosing generators f_1, ..., f_r of I, the proof exhibits the object (C x C', B_{f_i}, alpha_i, alpha_{ij}) of the gluing category Glue(B -> B-hat, f_1, ..., f_r), for which it states that the verification of conditions (1)(a) and (1)(b) is omitted (proof lines 32062-32074). Because B -> B-hat is flat and induces an isomorphism on B/IB, the equivalence proposition and the formal gluing remark apply, giving that C x C' is isomorphic to D tensor_B B-hat for some finite B-algebra D (proof lines 32075-32081). The rest is a Hensel-type lifting argument: the idempotent of D/ID corresponding to the factor C/IC is lifted after an etale base change B -> B' trivial modulo I, using that the pair (C x C', IC x IC') is henselian since C x C' is I-adically complete, and the henselian-pair criterion lets B -> C x C' factor through B'; replacing B by B' and D by D' splits D = D_e x D_{1-e} into a product of finite type A-algebras whose completions are C and C' (proof lines 32082-32096). The gluing formalism, the etale idempotent lifting and the Hensel pair argument are independent research-level content.
